en.GUILD_TUTORIAL_MAIN_STEP_1: New features have been added to guilds! Let's go over them one at a time.
en.GUILD_TUTORIAL_MAIN_STEP_2: Guild Coins are a commodity guilds can get. The Guildmaster and Submaster can exchange them at the Contribution Swap Shop.
en.GUILD_TUTORIAL_MAIN_STEP_3: Contribution is a commodity each guild member can get. It can be exchanged at the Contribution Swap Shop.
en.GUILD_TUTORIAL_MAIN_STEP_4: Guild members can use the Resource Request menu to request materials they need from each other and support each other.

en.GUILD_TUTORIAL_MISSION_STEP_1: Daily Missions have been added to Guild Missions. Guild Daily Missions are individual missions that guild member can each clear!

en.GUILD_TUTORIAL_SUPPORT_STEP_1: With this, every day guild members can request the materials they need from each other and support each other.
en.GUILD_TUTORIAL_SUPPORT_STEP_2: Using the Request button, you can request materials you need from guild members. (5-Star and 4-Star materials have 2-day and 1-day request wait times respectively at the time of the request based on all applicable rarities)
en.GUILD_TUTORIAL_SUPPORT_STEP_3: You can support guild members with the resources they requested. You will give them your own materials, so think carefully before you do support!
en.GUILD_TUTORIAL_SUPPORT_STEP_4: You'll get Contribution every time you support a guild member. The amount of Contribution you can get from support every day is fixed, and you can't support more than that.
en.GUILD_TUTORIAL_SUPPORT_STEP_5: The resources you requested can be gotten at the guild lobby whenever you receive support. However, the materials will disappear after 1 day passes, so be careful not to miss them!
en.GUILD_TUTORIAL_SWAPSHOP_STEP_1: The Contribution Swap Shop has been added.
en.GUILD_TUTORIAL_SWAPSHOP_STEP_2: The items at the Contribution Swap Shop can be exchanged for with Guild Coins and Contribution. (However, Guild Coins will only display and be usable for Guildmasters and Submasters)
